method_scopes.method: Native PRC2 RIP-seq (Zhao et al., 2010; PMID 21172659)
method_scopes.rationale: The cited primary paper combines native α-Ezh2 RIP of mouse ES-cell nuclear RNA with strand-preserving template-switch cDNA libraries and Illumina sequencing. No RNase trimming is reported in this library-production route. Its RNase pretreatments and UV-crosslink RIP/RT-qPCR are validation experiments, not extra steps or branches of the sequenced native library. This is the paper-supported implementation, not a demonstrated RNase-trimmed version of it.
